verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a 160-hectare estate on the southwest coast of Tenerife in Guia de Isora.
verified_facts.excerpt: 160-hectare estate on the southwest coast in Guia de Isora

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites draw on the heritage of the Guanches, the ancient indigenous people of Tenerife, and on the island's volcanic landscapes and gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the tribal heritage of the Guanches – the ancient indigenous people of Tenerife - the resort’s rooms and suites combine a contemporary and luxurious aesthetic with elements of the island's volcanic landscapes and lush gardens.

verified_facts.text: The Retreat is made up of four lanes of two-story casitas set against the hillside among subtropical gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gently nestled against the hillside and surrounded by leafy subtropical gardens, The Retreat consists of four lanes of two-story casitas

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Suite has a large outdoor terrace with its own private swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: a large outdoor terrace with its own private swimming pool

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suites are on the 7th and 8th floors of the Citadel and each has two bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal Suites are located on the 7th and 8th floors of the resort Citadel, each with two bedrooms

verified_facts.text: Guests have a dedicated area with sunbeds and umbrellas at Abama Beach, complimentary and subject to availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests enjoy access to Abama Beach, where a dedicated area with sunbeds and umbrellas is available on a complimentary basis, subject to availability.

verified_facts.text: A private train takes guests down to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The beach can be reached in comfort aboard our private train, offering a scenic and leisurely ride down to the shore.

verified_facts.text: M.B is led by Chef Erlantz Gorostiza under the vision of Martín Berasategui.
verified_facts.excerpt: Led by Chef Erlantz Gorostiza under Martín Berasategui’s vision

verified_facts.text: Akira Back Tenerife brings chef Akira Back's cooking to Spain for the first time.
verified_facts.excerpt: Akira Back Tenerife brings Chef Akira Back’s global culinary vision to Spain for the first time

verified_facts.text: Verde Mar serves a farm-to-table menu built on local produce and guided by the seasons.
verified_facts.excerpt: Verde Mar celebrates the essence of local produce through a refined farm-to-table experience. Guided by the seasons

verified_facts.text: The Beach Club restaurant is on the sand of Abama Beach, with views of La Gomera.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on the golden sands of Abama Beach with views of La Gomera

verified_facts.text: The Serenity Pool welcomes guests aged 13 and above and overlooks the Abama golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Serenity Pool welcomes guests aged 13 and above. Overlooking the Abama golf course

verified_facts.text: The Del Mar Infinity pool is reserved for guests staying at The Retreat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reserved to guests staying at The Retreat and part of the new Club experience, the Del Mar Infinity pool

verified_facts.text: The spa has a water circuit with a hydrotherapy pool, Turkish hammam, sauna, herbal steam, cold plunge pool, kneipp walk and world of showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Water facilities (Hydrotherapy pool, Turkish hammam, sauna, herbal steam, cold plunge pool, kneipp walk and world of showers)

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests without a spa treatment can use the spa water facilities for a 25 € entrance fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel guests can also experience the Water facilities (Hydrotherapy pool, Turkish hammam, sauna, herbal steam, cold plunge pool, kneipp walk and world of showers) without having a spa treatment for a 25 € entrance fee.

verified_facts.text: Guests of the spa must be at least 18 years old to have spa treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of the Spa must be at least 18 years of age or older to experience Spa treatments and Rituals.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Kids club runs daily activities for children aged 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: An agenda of activities (kids from 4 to 12 years old) such as arts & crafts, workshops, karaoke and much more, is available daily

verified_facts.text: Resort experiences include watercolor painting workshops, birdhouse painting and visits to the koi ponds.
verified_facts.excerpt: From watercolor painting workshops and creative sessions painting on fabric, such as bags and caps, to birdhouse painting and serene moments by the koi ponds

verified_facts.text: A championship golf course overlooking the Atlantic Ocean and La Gomera is available to guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may also enjoy a championship golf course overlooking the Atlantic Ocean and La Gomera island.

verified_facts.text: Pool opening days and times may vary according to seasonality.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opening days and times may vary according to seasonality.
